worldcombat.skill.sweetkiss.summary: Confuse a nearby target: its actions may be wasted, and landing a hit turns its own force back on it. Higher friendship extends the confusion.
worldcombat.skill.sweetkiss.use.1: Open a miss window before an ally's focus fire
worldcombat.skill.sweetkiss.use.2: Make an opponent's combo fumble in a grapple
It only lands within kissing distance (%1$s blocks, scaled by body size); with the current form that distance is %2$s blocks. Out of reach it simply misses, at no PP cost.

A kissed target is left confused for %1$s: each action has a 30% chance to be wasted (40% for a Deep kiss), and landing a hit on an enemy backlashes for about 2%–14% of its maximum health, scaling with its Attack. A repeat kiss only refreshes the confusion, never stacks it, and higher friendship means a longer daze.

Leaning in and delivering the kiss takes %1$s, the recovery is %2$s and the cooldown %3$s. The kiss is a choice: a Light kiss has x0.9 cooldown and x0.8 confusion duration; a Deep kiss adds +6 ticks of wind-up, +4 of recovery and x1.15 cooldown, buying x1.3 confusion duration and +10 percentage points of fumble chance.
worldcombat.skill.sweetkiss.preference.k: Light: x0.9 cooldown and x0.8 confusion duration, the quickest to work with. Deep: +6 ticks wind-up, +4 recovery and x1.15 cooldown, buying x1.3 confusion duration and +10 percentage points of fumble chance — good for locking one target down in melee.
worldcombat.skill.sweetkiss.preference.a: The partner only considers closing in while a threat is this close; smaller keeps it in melee, larger lets it chase out.
Anytime: close in and kiss any threat. When bitten: kiss only right after the partner is hit, as payback for whoever came close.
When on, the partner will also leave its post to kiss.
